This is the first post on this site. I'll use this space to write up notes on:

- Papers I find interesting from the ID literature
- Methodological notes on R tools I use
- Occasional longer pieces on epidemiology and AMR

## Why a blog?

Writing things down is how I process ideas. If it's useful to anyone else, great.

## What to expect

Posts will vary in length and depth — some will be brief notes, some longer pieces. I'll tag everything with categories so it's easy to filter.
